query: Three things: can you build a co-branded video template partners can localize, roughly how long for a first batch of ~20, and do you have a partner event example?

props.title: A Co-Branded Video Template Partners Can Localize
props.subtitle: Template video, partner events and a first batch of around 20
props.challengeSummary: You're asking about a co-branded video template that partners can adapt for their own markets, how long a first batch of about 20 would take, and whether there is a partner event example to look at.

props.caption: The co-branded video we made for AWS and NVIDIA's Project Ceiba

props.title: Fix the Core, Flex the Edges
props.content: For a localizable template, our approach would be to lock what makes the story recognizable, such as the narrative spine and the co-branding rules, and open up only what each partner genuinely needs to change. Every video in the batch then feels related without feeling identical.

props.title: AWS/NVIDIA: Co-Branded Video for a Visionary Collaboration
props.summary: We creative directed a co-branded video for AWS and NVIDIA's Project Ceiba, from concept to execution, blending interviews, use cases and custom 3D animations. Multi-channel distribution achieved over 8 million combined views.

props.title: UpShow/ChromeOS: Purposeful Partner Marketing
props.summary: We made UpShow-branded :10, :15 and :30 video ads, interactive media ads, and landing page copy and design that pitch UpShow's value while reinforcing ChromeOS messaging.

props.title: Android: Crafting a Brand New Virtual Event
props.summary: We built the "Art of Control" virtual event for Android Enterprise, including content planning, name and look & feel, speaker scripts, custom motion graphics, post-production and promotional assets. It featured discussions between Google, industry thought leaders and customers like Walmart and the FBI.

final.explanation: We haven't published a localizable video template, so the AWS/NVIDIA film is our closest co-branded work and the UpShow ads are adjacent partner-marketing work. We'd start by asking a few partners what they actually need to change locally, and build the first video around those answers. We also haven't published a partner event, and the Android virtual event is the nearest event work, not a partner event. Timing for a first batch depends on scope, so our Strategy Lead can scope it with you.
